name: Talking Heads

whyMatters.en: CBGB-origin band formed in 1975. Remain in Light (1980, with Brian Eno) stacked polyrhythm, looped guitar, and David Byrne’s vocal into a dense new-wave studio peak.
whyMatters.zh: 源自 CBGB 的乐队，1975 年成立。《Remain in Light》（1980，与 Brian Eno 合作）把复合节奏、循环吉他与 David Byrne 人声叠成密集的 new wave 录音室高峰。

essentialTracks.title: This Must Be the Place (Naive Melody)

note.en: Nervous funk trio before Harrison; bass ostinato and dry drums.
note.zh: Harrison 加入前的紧张 funk 三人编制；贝斯固定音型与干鼓。

note.en: Eno-era polyrhythm, looped parts, Byrne spoken-sung hook.
note.zh: Eno 时期复合节奏、循环声部、Byrne 说唱钩子。

note.en: Speaking in Tongues hit; expanded live band, MTV-scale chorus.
note.zh: 《Speaking in Tongues》热单；扩编现场乐队、MTV 尺度副歌。

interviewQuotes.speaker: David Byrne

interviewQuotes.text: We wanted to make music you could dance to without looking stupid.

shortBio.en: Byrne / Harrison / Weymouth / Frantz new wave, 1975–1991. Once in a Lifetime is the mass entry.
shortBio.zh: Byrne / Harrison / Weymouth / Frantz 的 new wave，1975–1991。《Once in a Lifetime》是大众入口。

body.en:
Talking Heads formed in New York in 1975. Talking Heads: 77 and More Songs About Buildings and Food established nervous funk; Fear of Music and Remain in Light expanded African and American rhythm collaboration and studio layering with Brian Eno.

Once in a Lifetime (1980) is the listed track. Speaking in Tongues (1983) brought MTV hits including Burning Down the House. The band ended in 1991. Later art-rock and alternative acts cite Remain in Light’s density and dance-grid writing.
body.zh:
Talking Heads 于 1975 年在纽约成立。《Talking Heads: 77》与《More Songs About Buildings and Food》确立紧张 funk；《Fear of Music》与《Remain in Light》在 Brian Eno 合作下扩展非裔与美洲节奏合作与录音室分层。

《Once in a Lifetime》（1980）是列出曲目。《Speaking in Tongues》（1983）带来包括《Burning Down the House》在内的 MTV 热单。乐队于 1991 年结束。后来 art-rock 与 alternative 行动常引用《Remain in Light》的密度与舞曲节奏写法。

title.zh: Art-funk 进入 new-wave 录音室密度

body.en:
CBGB tightness plus Weymouth and Frantz’s groove becomes Remain in Light’s looped polyrhythm with Eno.

Dense studio layering without dropping the dance grid.
body.zh:
CBGB 紧凑加上 Weymouth 与 Frantz 的 groove，经 Eno 变成《Remain in Light》的循环复合节奏。

密集录音室分层，不丢舞曲网格。

title.en: Trio CBGB to four plus Eno era
title.zh: CBGB 三人到四人 + Eno 时期

body.en:
Early Heads: Byrne, Weymouth, Frantz. Harrison joins in 1977. Remain in Light adds session players in the studio while the public lineup stays four.

Versions are mainly production states, not singer swaps.
body.zh:
早期 Heads：Byrne、Weymouth、Frantz。Harrison 于 1977 年加入。《Remain in Light》在录音室加 session，公众阵容仍四人。

版本主要是制作状态，而非换主唱。

body.en:
Spoken-sung verses over interlocking bass, guitar, and keys. The MTV video fixes Byrne’s water-gesture stage image.

Clear entry for the Remain in Light method.
body.zh:
互锁贝斯、吉他与键盘上的说唱主歌。MTV 录像固定 Byrne 的泼水手势舞台形象。

《Remain in Light》方法的清楚入口。

body.en:
Byrne’s angular guitar and nervous baritone sit on Weymouth’s melodic funk bass and Frantz’s dry kick. Harrison adds keys and guitar color.

Tom Tom Club (Weymouth/Frantz) shows the rhythm section can carry a separate hit catalog.
body.zh:
Byrne 棱角吉他与紧张男中音坐在 Weymouth 旋律 funk 贝斯与 Frantz 干底鼓上。Harrison 加键盘与吉他色彩。

Tom Tom Club（Weymouth/Frantz）显示节奏组可承载独立热单目录。

body.en:
Weymouth’s dance claim and Byrne’s lyric catchphrase document the Heads bargain: art posture plus floor utility.

Quotes label method; the records carry the argument.
body.zh:
Weymouth 的舞曲主张与 Byrne 歌词口头禅记录 Heads 的取舍：艺术姿态加上舞池效用。

引语标注方法；论证仍由唱片承担。

title.en: Post-punk as dance and studio system
title.zh: 后朋克作为舞曲与录音室系统

body.en:
Radiohead and later art-rock cite Remain in Light density. Depeche Mode and new-wave peers share the dance-grid inheritance.

CBGB tightness scaled to polyrhythm albums.
body.zh:
Radiohead 与后来 art-rock 引用《Remain in Light》密度。Depeche Mode 与 new-wave 同辈共享舞曲网格遗产。

CBGB 紧凑扩到复合节奏专辑。

note.en: Remain in Light through Speaking in Tongues peak years.
note.zh: 《Remain in Light》至《Speaking in Tongues》峰值年。

note.en: Eno-era polyrhythm as new-wave mass entry.
note.zh: Eno 时期复合节奏，new-wave 大众入口。

note.en: Art-school funk and studio looping without glam costume.
note.zh: 艺术学院 funk 与录音室循环，无 glam 戏服。
